en.B: But do not be glad because the spirits obey you. Be glad instead that your names stand written in heaven."
en.R: But do not be happy because the spirits obey you. Be happy because your names are written in heaven."

es.L: Sin embargo, no {{plural_you:se alegren|os alegréis}} de esto, de que los espíritus se {{plural_you:les|os}} someten, sino {{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} de que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} nombres han sido escritos en los cielos».
es.B: Pero no {{plural_you:se alegren|os alegréis}} porque los espíritus {{plural_you:les|os}} obedecen. {{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} más bien porque {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} nombres están escritos en el cielo».
es.R: Pero no {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} contentos porque los espíritus {{plural_you:les|os}} obedecen. {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} contentos porque {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} nombres están escritos en el cielo».

fr.L: Cependant, ne vous réjouissez pas de ceci, que les esprits vous sont soumis, mais réjouissez-vous de ce que vos noms ont été inscrits dans les cieux. »
fr.B: Pourtant, ne vous réjouissez pas de ce que les esprits vous obéissent ; réjouissez-vous plutôt de ce que vos noms sont inscrits dans le ciel. »
fr.R: Mais ne soyez pas heureux parce que les esprits vous obéissent. Soyez heureux parce que vos noms sont écrits dans le ciel. »

sw.L: Lakini msifurahi kwa hili, kwamba roho wanawatii, bali furahini kwa kuwa majina yenu yameandikwa mbinguni."
sw.B: Lakini msifurahi kwa sababu roho hao wanawatii. Afadhali furahini kwa sababu majina yenu yameandikwa mbinguni."
sw.R: Lakini msifurahi kwa sababu pepo hao wanawatii. Furahini kwa sababu majina yenu yameandikwa mbinguni."

vi.L: Tuy vậy, đừng vui mừng về điều này, là các linh phục các con, nhưng hãy vui mừng vì tên các con đã được ghi trong các tầng trời."
vi.B: Nhưng đừng vui mừng vì các linh vâng phục các con. Hãy vui mừng vì tên các con đã được ghi trên trời."
vi.R: Nhưng đừng vui vì các tà linh vâng lời các con. Hãy vui vì tên các con đã được ghi trên trời."

decisions.choice: the spirits: the demons of 10:17
decisions.reason: Luke calls demons unclean or evil spirits (4:33; 8:2).

decisions.choice: your names are written in heaven: they belong to God's people for ever
alternatives: their names are honored on earth
decisions.reason: Scripture speaks of a book in which God writes the names of his people (Exodus 32:32; Daniel 12:1; Philippians 4:3). The perfect tense says the names stand written.

decisions.choice: do not rejoice ... but rejoice: the greater reason for joy
alternatives: they must take no pleasure in their power
decisions.reason: "Not this, but that" is a Hebrew way of setting one thing far above another. Jesus points them from what they can do to what God has done for them.

decisions.choice: be glad (B); be happy (R)
decisions.reason: Everyday words for rejoicing.

decisions.choice: heaven
decisions.reason: The plural follows the Hebrew way of speaking of heaven; Balanced and Readable use the singular, as English usually does.

decisions.choice: réjouissez-vous (B)
decisions.reason: English Balanced says "be glad" because "rejoice" sounds churchy. French "se réjouir" is ordinary careful French, so Balanced keeps it; Readable says "soyez heureux", as the English "be happy".

decisions.choice: roho (L, B); pepo (R)
decisions.reason: The spirits are the demons of 10:17 (meaning decision m1). Literal and Balanced keep the Greek word, "roho", with personal agreement ("wanawatii") and "hao" pointing back to the demons; Readable names them plainly.

decisions.choice: "trong các tầng trời" (L); "trên trời" (B, R) for "in the heavens"
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 6:9: Literal keeps the Greek plural, Balanced and Readable say "trên trời".

source.text: Ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἠγαλλιάσατο τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἁγίῳ καὶ εἶπεν· Ἐξομολογοῦμαί σοι, πάτερ κύριε τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἀπέκρυψας ταῦτα ἀπὸ σοφῶν καὶ συνετῶν, καὶ ἀπεκάλυψας αὐτὰ νηπίοις· ναί, ὁ πατήρ, ὅτι οὕτως εὐδοκία ἐγένετο ἔμπροσθέν σου.

records.literal_gloss: In the same hour he rejoiced in the Spirit the Holy and said, I praise you, Father, Lord of the heaven and of the earth, that you hid these things from wise and understanding and revealed them to little children; yes, Father, for thus well-pleasing it was before you.

en.L: In that same hour {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and said, "I praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hid these things from [the] wise and understanding and revealed them to little children; yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: At that very time Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and said, "I praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have kept these things hidden from the wise and the clever, and have made them known to little children. Yes, Father, for this is what seemed good to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: At that time Jesus was moved by the Holy Spirit and was very glad. He said, "Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. You have hidden these things from people who are wise and clever. But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have shown them to people who are like little children. Yes, Father, this is what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} wanted to do.

es.L: En aquella misma hora se llenó de júbilo en el Espíritu Santo y dijo: «Te alabo, Padre, Señor del cielo y de la tierra, porque ocultaste estas cosas a [los] sabios e inteligentes, y las revelaste a niños pequeños; sí, Padre, porque así fue agradable delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: En ese mismo momento, Jesús se llenó de alegría en el Espíritu Santo y dijo: «Te alabo, Padre, Señor del cielo y de la tierra, porque has escondido estas cosas a los sabios y a los entendidos, y se las has mostrado a los pequeños. Sí, Padre, porque eso es lo que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pareció bien.
es.R: En ese momento, Jesús, movido por el Espíritu Santo, se alegró mucho y dijo: «Padre, Señor del cielo y de la tierra, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabo. Has escondido estas cosas de la gente sabia y lista. Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} se las has mostrado a los que son como niños pequeños. Sí, Padre, esto es lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quisiste hacer.

fr.L: À cette heure même, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} exulta dans l’Esprit Saint et dit : « Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loue, Père, Seigneur du ciel et de la terre, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as caché ces choses aux sages et aux intelligents et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as révélées aux petits enfants ; oui, Père, car c’est ainsi que cela a été agréable devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Au même moment, Jésus exulta de joie dans l’Esprit Saint et dit : « Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loue, Père, Seigneur du ciel et de la terre, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as tenu ces choses cachées aux sages et aux gens habiles, et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as fait connaître aux petits enfants. Oui, Père, c’est ce qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}a semblé bon.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, l’Esprit Saint a rempli Jésus d’une grande joie. Il a dit : « Père, Seigneur du ciel et de la terre, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loue. Tu as caché ces choses aux gens sages et intelligents. Mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as montrées à ceux qui sont comme de petits enfants. Oui, Père, c’est cela que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as voulu faire.

sw.L: Katika saa hiyo hiyo alifurahi sana katika Roho Mtakatifu, akasema, "Ninakusifu, Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na dunia, kwa sababu uliyasitiri mambo haya kwa wenye hekima na wenye ufahamu, ukayadhihirisha kwa watoto wadogo. Ndiyo, Baba, kwa kuwa hivyo ndivyo lilivyokuwa jambo la kupendeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wakati huo huo Yesu alijawa na furaha kuu katika Roho Mtakatifu, akasema, "Ninakusifu, Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na dunia, kwa sababu mambo haya umeyaweka sirini kwa wenye hekima na wenye elimu, na umeyafunua kwa watoto wadogo. Ndiyo, Baba, kwa kuwa hivi ndivyo ulivyoona vyema.
sw.R: Wakati huo Roho Mtakatifu alimgusa Yesu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akafurahi sana. Akasema, "Baba, Bwana wa mbingu na dunia, ninakusifu. Umewaficha mambo haya watu wenye hekima na elimu. Lakini umewaonyesha watu walio kama watoto wadogo. Ndiyo, Baba, hivi ndivyo ulivyotaka kufanya.

vi.L: Ngay giờ ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hớn hở vui mừng trong Đức Thánh Linh và nói: "Lạy Cha, Chúa của trời và đất, Con ngợi khen Cha, vì Cha đã giấu những điều này khỏi những người khôn ngoan và hiểu biết, mà bày tỏ chúng cho những con trẻ; vâng, lạy Cha, vì điều ấy đẹp ý Cha.
vi.B: Ngay lúc ấy, Đức Giê-xu hớn hở vui mừng trong Đức Thánh Linh và nói: "Lạy Cha, là Chúa của trời và đất, Con ngợi khen Cha, vì Cha đã giấu những điều này khỏi người khôn ngoan và người thông sáng, mà bày tỏ cho những con trẻ. Vâng, lạy Cha, vì Cha vui lòng muốn như vậy.
vi.R: Lúc ấy Đức Thánh Linh làm cho Đức Giê-xu tràn đầy niềm vui. Ngài cầu nguyện: "Lạy Cha, là Chúa của trời và đất, Con ngợi khen Cha! Cha đã giấu những điều này khỏi những người khôn ngoan và có học thức. Nhưng Cha đã cho những người giống như trẻ nhỏ được biết. Vâng, lạy Cha, đó là điều Cha muốn làm.

decisions.choice: rejoiced in the Holy Spirit (SBLGNT)
alternatives: rejoiced in the spirit (his own spirit)
Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ here. Many early ones read "the Holy Spirit", with or without the word "in"; many later ones have "in the spirit" without "Holy", meaning Jesus's own spirit, and some name Jesus. The SBLGNT reads "the Holy Spirit" without "in". Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: rejoiced in the Holy Spirit: was filled with exultant joy that came from the Spirit
alternatives: was glad in his own spirit
decisions.reason: The verb means to rejoice greatly, as Mary rejoices in God (1:47). Luke ties Jesus's joy to the Spirit, as he tied his ministry to the Spirit (4:1, 14, 18).

decisions.choice: I praise you: I openly acknowledge you with thanks
alternatives: I confess my sins to you
decisions.reason: The verb means to declare openly. Spoken to God it means to praise him and agree with what he has done (Romans 15:9).

decisions.choice: these things: what the disciples are seeing of the kingdom of God
decisions.reason: "These things" is not spelled out. In context it is the meaning of Jesus's work and the coming of the kingdom (10:9, 18, 23-24).

decisions.choice: little children: people without learning or standing
decisions.reason: The word means infants. Here it stands for people like the disciples, who had no training in the law (Acts 4:13), in contrast with those counted wise.

decisions.choice: well-pleasing: what God was pleased to choose
decisions.reason: The word means good pleasure or gracious will, as in "people of his good pleasure" (2:14).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus at the start of a new section.

decisions.choice: short sentences; "moved by the Holy Spirit and was very glad"
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the prayer into short sentences and says plainly how the Spirit and Jesus's joy are connected, following the meaning decision above.

decisions.choice: Te alabo, with no span
decisions.reason: The English marks "you" in "I praise you". In Spanish the pronoun opens the prayer and is capitalised either way, so it takes no span there; Readable, where it stands inside the sentence, has the span.

decisions.choice: l’Esprit Saint (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form, as in John and Mark. Readable makes the Spirit the source of Jesus's joy ("l'Esprit Saint a rempli Jésus d'une grande joie"), following the meaning decision as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: ninakusifu
decisions.reason: The verb is to acknowledge someone openly, with thanks (meaning decision m3). "Kushukuru" says only thanks; "kusifu" keeps the open praise, as the English "I praise you" does.

decisions.choice: "Con" for "I" and "Cha" for "you" in Jesus's prayer, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As in the parallel Matthew 11:25-26, whose wording Luke shares and which Vietnamese follows: "Cha" and "Con" are capitalised nouns of address and take no span.

decisions.choice: "hớn hở vui mừng trong Đức Thánh Linh" (L, B); "Đức Thánh Linh làm cho ... tràn đầy niềm vui" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says exultant joy that came from the Spirit; "hớn hở" carries the exultation, and Readable names the Spirit as its source.

source.text: πάντα μοι παρεδόθη ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ οὐδεὶς γινώσκει τίς ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς εἰ μὴ ὁ πατήρ, καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ πατὴρ εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν βούληται ὁ υἱὸς ἀποκαλύψαι.

records.literal_gloss: All things to me were handed over by the Father of me, and no one knows who is the Son except the Father, and who is the Father except the Son and to whom if wishes the Son to reveal.

en.L: All things have been handed over to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father, and no one knows who the Son is except the Father, and who the Father is except the Son and [anyone] to whom the Son wishes to reveal [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}]."
en.B: My Father has put all things into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands. Who the Son is, only the Father knows; and who the Father is, only the Son knows, along with anyone to whom the Son is willing to make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} known."
en.R: My Father has given everything to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Only the Father knows who the Son is. And only the Son knows who the Father is. The Son also shows who the Father is to the people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chooses."

es.L: Todas las cosas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fueron entregadas por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre, y nadie conoce quién es el Hijo sino el Padre, ni quién es el Padre sino el Hijo y [aquel] a quien el Hijo quiera [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] revelar».
es.B: Mi Padre ha puesto todas las cosas en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos. Quién es el Hijo, solo lo sabe el Padre; y quién es el Padre, solo lo sabe el Hijo, y aquellos a quienes el Hijo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} quiera dar a conocer».
es.R: Mi Padre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado todo. Solo el Padre sabe quién es el Hijo. Y solo el Hijo sabe quién es el Padre. El Hijo también muestra quién es el Padre a las personas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escoge».

fr.L: Toutes choses {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont été remises par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père, et personne ne connaît qui est le Fils, sinon le Père, ni qui est le Père, sinon le Fils et [celui] à qui le Fils veut [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] révéler. »
fr.B: Mon Père a tout remis entre {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains. Qui est le Fils, le Père seul le sait ; et qui est le Père, seul le Fils le sait, ainsi que celui à qui le Fils veut bien {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire connaître. »
fr.R: Mon Père {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a tout donné. Seul le Père sait qui est le Fils. Et seul le Fils sait qui est le Père. Le Fils montre aussi qui est le Père aux personnes qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} choisit. »

sw.L: Mambo yote yamekabidhiwa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} na Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na hakuna mtu anayejua Mwana ni nani isipokuwa Baba, na Baba ni nani isipokuwa Mwana, na [yeyote] ambaye Mwana atataka kumfunulia [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}]."
sw.B: Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ameweka vitu vyote mikononi {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}. Mwana ni nani, anajua Baba peke yake; na Baba ni nani, anajua Mwana peke yake, pamoja na wale ambao Mwana yuko tayari kuwajulisha habari {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}."
sw.R: Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} amenipa kila kitu. Ni Baba peke yake anayejua Mwana ni nani. Na ni Mwana peke yake anayejua Baba ni nani. Mwana pia huwaonyesha Baba ni nani watu wale ambao {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huwachagua."

vi.L: Mọi sự đã được Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giao cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và không ai biết Con là ai ngoại trừ Cha, cũng không ai biết Cha là ai ngoại trừ Con và người nào mà Con muốn bày tỏ [Cha] cho."
vi.B: Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giao phó mọi sự cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Không ai biết Con là ai, ngoại trừ Cha; cũng không ai biết Cha là ai, ngoại trừ Con và những người mà Con muốn bày tỏ Cha cho họ."
vi.R: Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giao mọi sự cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Chỉ có Cha biết Con là ai. Và chỉ có Con biết Cha là ai. Con cũng cho những người Con chọn được biết Cha."

decisions.choice: all things handed over: all authority and all knowledge of the Father
alternatives: only the teaching he passes on
decisions.reason: The Father has given all things into the Son's hand (John 3:35; Matthew 28:18). In context this includes the knowledge of God that the Son reveals.

decisions.choice: knows: a close, personal knowing between the Father and the Son
decisions.reason: Only the Father truly knows the Son, and only the Son truly knows the Father (John 10:15). Jesus speaks of himself as "the Son".

decisions.choice: to reveal him: the Father
decisions.reason: The object is not stated; the sentence implies it is the Father, whom only the Son knows.

decisions.choice: no introduction (SBLGNT)
alternatives: And turning to the disciples, he said
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts begin the verse with these words, probably taken from 10:23; early manuscripts do not have them. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: My Father has put all things into my hands (B); My Father has given everything to me (R)
alternatives: All things have been handed over to me by my Father
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the Father the subject, which is plainer than the passive.

decisions.choice: "Con" and "Cha" repeated where the English has pronouns, with no span
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 11:27: the nouns are capitalised and take no setting, so the English pronoun spans have no counterpart.

source.text: Καὶ στραφεὶς πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς κατ’ ἰδίαν εἶπεν· Μακάριοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ οἱ βλέποντες ἃ βλέπετε.

records.literal_gloss: And having turned to the disciples privately he said, Blessed the eyes that see what you see.

en.L: And turning to the disciples, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said privately, "Blessed [are] the eyes that see the things you see.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} turned to the disciples and said to them alone, "Blessed are the eyes that are seeing what you see.
en.R: Then Jesus turned to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} followers and spoke to them alone. He said, "How blessed are the eyes that see what you are seeing!

es.L: Y volviéndose hacia los discípulos, les dijo aparte: «Dichosos los ojos que ven lo que {{plural_you:ustedes ven|vosotros veis}}.
es.B: Luego se volvió hacia los discípulos y les dijo a solas: «Dichosos los ojos que están viendo lo que {{plural_you:ustedes ven|vosotros veis}}.
es.R: Luego Jesús se volvió hacia {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos y les habló solo a ellos. Les dijo: «¡Qué dichosos son los ojos que ven lo que {{plural_you:ustedes están viendo|vosotros estáis viendo}}!

fr.L: Et, se tournant vers les disciples, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit en particulier : « Heureux les yeux qui voient ce que vous voyez.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se tourna vers les disciples et leur dit, à eux seuls : « Ils sont heureux, les yeux qui voient ce que vous voyez.
fr.R: Puis Jésus s’est tourné vers {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples, et il leur a parlé à eux seuls. Il leur a dit : « Quel bonheur pour les yeux qui voient ce que vous voyez !

sw.L: Na alipogeuka kuwaelekea wanafunzi, aliwaambia faraghani, "Heri [ni] macho yanayoona mambo mnayoyaona.
sw.B: Kisha akawageukia wanafunzi, akasema nao peke yao, "Heri macho yanayoona yale mnayoyaona sasa.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu aliwageukia wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, akaongea nao peke yao. Alisema, "Heri kubwa ni ya macho yanayoona mambo mnayoyaona ninyi!

vi.L: Và quay lại với các môn đồ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói riêng: "Phước cho những con mắt thấy những điều các con thấy.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay lại phía các môn đồ và nói riêng với họ: "Phước cho những con mắt được thấy những điều các con đang thấy.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu quay lại với các môn đồ và nói riêng với họ: "Những ai được thấy điều các con đang thấy thật có phước!

decisions.choice: privately: to the disciples alone
decisions.reason: Jesus turns from his prayer to speak to the disciples apart from the crowd.

decisions.choice: blessed: happy and favored by God
decisions.reason: As in the Beatitudes (6:20-22), the word speaks of the good God gives.

decisions.choice: the eyes that see: the people who see
decisions.reason: The eyes stand for the people themselves. What they see is Jesus's work and the coming of the kingdom of God.

decisions.choice: How blessed
decisions.reason: As in 6:20-22, Readable makes the saying an exclamation.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus.

decisions.choice: dichosos
decisions.reason: The word used across the New Testament drafts: "dichoso" is happy and favored (meaning decision m2) and is still everyday Spanish, where "bienaventurado" now belongs to church language.

decisions.choice: Heureux (L, B); Quel bonheur pour (R)
decisions.reason: "Bienheureux" now sounds like church language; "heureux" is the plain word and, in this kind of saying, still carries the sense of being favored by God (m2). Readable makes the saying an exclamation, as the English does. Jesus's disciples are "disciples" at every level, where English Readable says "followers".

decisions.choice: heri
decisions.reason: The word used across the New Testament drafts for the happy state of those God favors (meaning decision m2); Readable says "heri kubwa" for the English "How blessed".

decisions.choice: "Phước cho" (L, B); "thật có phước" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 6:20-23: "phước" is God's favor and the happiness it brings (meaning decision). Readable says "những ai" for "the eyes", the people who see, as the meaning decision explains.

source.text: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ προφῆται καὶ βασιλεῖς ἠθέλησαν ἰδεῖν ἃ ὑμεῖς βλέπετε καὶ οὐκ εἶδαν, καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν.

records.literal_gloss: I say for to you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see and not saw, and to hear what you hear and not heard.

en.L: For I say to you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see and did not see [it], and to hear what you hear and did not hear [it]."
en.B: I tell you, many prophets and kings longed to see the things you are seeing, yet never saw them; they longed to hear the things you are hearing, yet never heard them."
en.R: I tell you, many prophets and kings in the past wished they could see what you see now. But they never saw it. They wished they could hear what you hear. But they never heard it."

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que muchos profetas y reyes quisieron ver lo que {{plural_you:ustedes ven|vosotros veis}}, y no [lo] vieron, y oír lo que {{plural_you:oyen|oís}}, y no [lo] oyeron».
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que muchos profetas y reyes desearon ver lo que {{plural_you:ustedes están viendo|vosotros estáis viendo}}, pero nunca lo vieron; desearon oír lo que {{plural_you:están oyendo|estáis oyendo}}, pero nunca lo oyeron».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que muchos profetas y reyes del pasado querían ver lo que {{plural_you:ustedes ven|vosotros veis}} ahora. Pero nunca lo vieron. Querían oír lo que {{plural_you:ustedes oyen|vosotros oís}}. Pero nunca lo oyeron».

fr.L: Car je vous dis que beaucoup de prophètes et de rois ont voulu voir ce que vous voyez, et ne [l’]ont pas vu, et entendre ce que vous entendez, et ne [l’]ont pas entendu. »
fr.B: Je vous le dis : beaucoup de prophètes et de rois ont désiré voir ce que vous voyez, mais ne l’ont jamais vu ; ils ont désiré entendre ce que vous entendez, mais ne l’ont jamais entendu. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis : autrefois, beaucoup de prophètes et de rois auraient voulu voir ce que vous voyez maintenant. Mais ils ne l’ont jamais vu. Ils auraient voulu entendre ce que vous entendez. Mais ils ne l’ont jamais entendu. »

sw.L: Kwa maana nawaambia kwamba manabii wengi na wafalme walitaka kuona mambo ambayo ninyi mnaona, nao hawakuyaona, na kusikia mambo ambayo mnasikia, nao hawakuyasikia."
sw.B: Nawaambia, manabii wengi na wafalme walitamani sana kuona mambo mnayoona sasa, lakini hawakuyaona; walitamani kusikia mambo mnayosikia, lakini hawakuyasikia."
sw.R: Nawaambia, manabii wengi na wafalme wa zamani walitaka kuona mambo mnayoyaona sasa. Lakini hawakuyaona. Walitaka kusikia mambo mnayoyasikia. Lakini hawakuyasikia."

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng nhiều nhà tiên tri và vua chúa đã muốn thấy những điều các con thấy mà không được thấy, và muốn nghe những điều các con nghe mà không được nghe."
vi.B: Ta nói với các con, nhiều nhà tiên tri và vua chúa đã ao ước được thấy những điều các con đang thấy, mà chẳng được thấy; ao ước được nghe những điều các con đang nghe, mà chẳng được nghe."
vi.R: Ta nói với các con, ngày xưa nhiều nhà tiên tri và nhiều vua đã ao ước được thấy những điều bây giờ các con đang thấy. Nhưng họ chẳng bao giờ được thấy. Họ ao ước được nghe những điều các con đang nghe. Nhưng họ chẳng bao giờ được nghe."

decisions.choice: prophets and kings: the faithful of Israel's past who waited for God's promises
decisions.reason: The prophets looked ahead to a salvation they did not live to see (1 Peter 1:10-12; Hebrews 11:13). David and other kings received promises about the coming king (1:32-33).

decisions.choice: for: giving the reason the disciples are blessed
decisions.reason: The disciples see what generations before them longed for.

decisions.choice: in the past; now
decisions.reason: Readable makes the contrast in time plain.

source.text: Καὶ ἰδοὺ νομικός τις ἀνέστη ἐκπειράζων αὐτὸν λέγων· Διδάσκαλε, τί ποιήσας ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

records.literal_gloss: And behold an expert in the law certain stood up testing him saying, Teacher, what having done eternal life will I inherit?

en.L: And look, a certain expert in the law stood up, testing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, saying, "Teacher, by doing what will I inherit eternal life?"
en.B: Then an expert in the law stood up to put Jesus to the test. "Teacher," he said, "what do I have to do to inherit eternal life?"
en.R: One day an expert in God's law stood up to test Jesus. He asked, "Teacher, what must I do to have eternal life?"

es.L: Y mira, cierto experto en la ley se levantó, poniéndolo a prueba, diciendo: «Maestro, ¿haciendo qué heredaré vida eterna?».
es.B: Entonces un experto en la ley se puso de pie para poner a prueba a Jesús. «Maestro —le dijo—, ¿qué tengo que hacer para heredar la vida eterna?».
es.R: Un día, un experto en la ley de Dios se puso de pie para poner a prueba a Jesús. Le preguntó: «Maestro, ¿qué debo hacer para tener vida eterna?».

fr.L: Et voici, un certain expert de la Loi se leva pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettre à l’épreuve, disant : « Maître, en faisant quoi hériterai-je de la vie éternelle ? »
fr.B: Alors un expert de la Loi se leva pour mettre Jésus à l’épreuve. « Maître, demanda-t-il, que dois-je faire pour hériter de la vie éternelle ? »
fr.R: Un jour, un expert de la Loi s’est levé pour mettre Jésus à l’épreuve. Il a demandé : « Maître, qu’est-ce que je dois faire pour avoir la vie éternelle ? »

sw.L: Na tazama, mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria alisimama akimjaribu, akisema, "Mwalimu, kwa kufanya nini nitaurithi uzima wa milele?"
sw.B: Kisha mtaalamu mmoja wa sheria alisimama ili amjaribu Yesu. Akasema, "Mwalimu, nitende nini ili nipate kurithi uzima wa milele?"
sw.R: Siku moja mtaalamu wa sheria ya Mungu alisimama ili kumjaribu Yesu. Aliuliza, "Mwalimu, nifanye nini ili niwe na uzima wa milele?"

vi.L: Và kìa, có một chuyên gia luật pháp kia đứng dậy thử {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nói rằng: "Thưa Thầy, tôi phải làm gì để thừa hưởng sự sống đời đời?"
vi.B: Có một chuyên gia luật pháp đứng dậy để thử Đức Giê-xu. Ông hỏi: "Thưa Thầy, tôi phải làm gì để được hưởng sự sống đời đời?"
vi.R: Một hôm, có một chuyên gia về luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời đứng dậy để thử Đức Giê-xu. Ông hỏi: "Thưa Thầy, tôi phải làm gì để nhận được sự sống đời đời?"

decisions.choice: expert in the law: a man trained in the law of Moses, much like the scribes
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word for the experts who taught and applied God's law (7:30; 11:45-52).

decisions.choice: testing him: putting him to the test, to see how he would answer
decisions.reason: The same verb is used when Jesus refuses to put God to the test (4:12). The expert wants to see whether Jesus's answer will stand up; his next question shows he also wanted to defend himself (10:29).

decisions.choice: inherit eternal life: receive the life of the age to come
decisions.reason: "Inherit" was used of Israel receiving the promised land (Deuteronomy 4:1). Eternal life is the life of the age to come (Daniel 12:2; Luke 18:18, 30). The question assumes there is something one must do to receive it.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence, as in Matthew 1:20.

decisions.choice: expert in God's law (R); expert in the law (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in 7:30. Today "lawyer" suggests courts and contracts.

decisions.choice: have
decisions.reason: Readable uses a simpler verb; the meaning decision explains "inherit".

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus, since "him" has no clear reference at the start of a new section.

decisions.choice: experto en la ley
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts for a man trained in the law of Moses (meaning decision m1). "Doctor" now suggests a physician, and "intérprete" a translator.

decisions.choice: poniéndolo a prueba, poner a prueba a Jesús, with no span
decisions.reason: The English Literal marks "him". Spanish joins the pronoun to the verb ("poniéndolo"), and Balanced and Readable name Jesus, so there is no separate pronoun to capitalise.

decisions.choice: un expert de la Loi (every level)
decisions.reason: "Docteur de la Loi" is the traditional phrase, but "docteur" now means a physician to most readers; "légiste" suggests forensic medicine. "Expert" says what the man was; As in 7:30; Readable uses the same phrase as for the scribes. "La Loi" is capitalised for the Law of Moses (style guide section 9), here and in 10:26.

decisions.choice: mtaalamu wa sheria
decisions.reason: The term used across the New Testament drafts for a man trained in the law of Moses (meaning decision m1). "Mwanasheria" is now a lawyer in a modern court.

decisions.choice: "chuyên gia luật pháp" (L, B); "chuyên gia về luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 7:30 for the same word; "luật sư" now means an attorney.

decisions.choice: "thừa hưởng" (L); "được hưởng" (B); "nhận được" (R) for "inherit"; "Thưa Thầy" with "tôi"
decisions.reason: As in Mark 10:17 for the same question; he speaks to Jesus as a teacher, with no setting span.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν· Ἐν τῷ νόμῳ τί γέγραπται;

records.literal_gloss: And he said to him, In the law what has been written?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to him, "What has been written in the law?
en.B: Jesus answered him, "What stands written in the law?
en.R: Jesus answered, "What does God's law say?

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le dijo: «En la ley, ¿qué está escrito?
es.B: Jesús le respondió: «¿Qué está escrito en la ley?
es.R: Jesús le contestó: «¿Qué dice la ley de Dios?

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Qu’est-il écrit dans la Loi ?
fr.B: Jésus lui répondit : « Qu’est-ce qui est écrit dans la Loi ?
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Que dit la Loi de Dieu ?

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Katika sheria imeandikwa nini?
sw.B: Yesu alimjibu, "Ni nini kilichoandikwa katika sheria?
sw.R: Yesu alijibu, "Sheria ya Mungu inasema nini?

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với ông: "Trong luật pháp có chép gì?
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Luật pháp chép thế nào?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời nói gì?

decisions.choice: the law: the law of Moses, the first five books of Scripture
decisions.reason: As in 2:22-24, the law is the law God gave through Moses.

decisions.choice: Jesus answers with a question
decisions.reason: He sends the expert back to the Scripture he knows, and lets him answer his own question.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: God's law
decisions.reason: Readable says whose law is meant.

decisions.choice: Jesus calls the expert "ông" (10:26-37)
decisions.reason: A learned grown man who tests him; "ông" is the polite word, as Jesus speaks to Simon the Pharisee in Luke 7:40-47.

source.text: πῶς ἀναγινώσκεις;

records.literal_gloss: How read you?

en.L: How do you read [it]?"
en.B: What do you read there?"
en.R: What do you understand it to say?"

es.L: ¿Cómo lees?».
es.B: ¿Qué lees allí?».
es.R: ¿Qué entiendes tú que dice?».

fr.L: Comment lis-tu ? »
fr.B: Qu’y lis-tu ? »
fr.R: Comment la comprends-tu ? »

sw.L: Unasomaje?"
sw.B: Unasoma nini humo?"
sw.R: Wewe unaelewa inasema nini?"

vi.L: Ông đọc thế nào?"
vi.B: Ông đọc thấy gì trong đó?"
vi.R: Ông hiểu điều đó thế nào?"

decisions.choice: how do you read it: what does it say, as you read it
decisions.reason: The question asks what the man finds in Scripture. He answers by quoting it.

decisions.choice: What (B); What do you understand it to say (R)
decisions.reason: "How" would suggest a question about method; Balanced and Readable ask what he finds there.

source.text: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Ἀγαπήσεις κύριον τὸν θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ἰσχύϊ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ διανοίᾳ σου, καὶ τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And answering he said, You shall love Lord the God of you with all the heart of you and with all the soul of you and with all the strength of you and with all the mind of you, and the neighbor of you as yourself.

en.L: And answering, he said, "'You shall love [the] Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind,' and 'your neighbor as yourself.'"
en.B: He answered, "'You are to love the Lord your God with your whole heart, your whole soul, your whole strength and your whole mind,' and 'your neighbor as you love yourself.'"
en.R: The man answered, "'Love the Lord your God with everything you are: with all your heart, all your soul, all your strength, and all your mind.' And, 'Love your neighbor as much as you love yourself.'"

es.L: Y él, respondiendo, dijo: «“Amarás [al] Señor tu Dios desde todo tu corazón, y con toda tu alma, y con toda tu fuerza, y con toda tu mente”, y “a tu prójimo como a ti mismo”».
es.B: Él respondió: «“Ama al Señor tu Dios con el corazón entero, con el alma entera, con todas las fuerzas y con toda la mente”, y “ama a tu prójimo como te amas a ti mismo”».
es.R: El hombre respondió: «“Ama al Señor tu Dios con todo lo que eres: con todo tu corazón, con toda tu alma, con todas tus fuerzas y con toda tu mente”. Y también: “Ama a tu prójimo tanto como te amas a ti mismo”».

fr.L: Et, répondant, il dit : « “Tu aimeras le Seigneur ton Dieu de tout ton cœur, et de toute ton âme, et de toute ta force, et de toute ta pensée”, et “ton prochain comme toi-même”. »
fr.B: Il répondit : « “Tu dois aimer le Seigneur ton Dieu de tout ton cœur, de toute ton âme, de toute ta force et de tout ton esprit”, et “ton prochain comme tu t’aimes toi-même”. »
fr.R: L’homme a répondu : « “Aime le Seigneur ton Dieu de tout ton être : de tout ton cœur, de toute ton âme, de toute ta force et de toute ton intelligence.” Et : “Aime ton prochain autant que tu t’aimes toi-même.” »

sw.L: Naye akajibu, akasema, "'Utampenda Bwana Mungu wako kutoka moyoni mwako mwote, na kwa nafsi yako yote, na kwa nguvu zako zote, na kwa akili yako yote,' na 'jirani yako kama wewe mwenyewe.'"
sw.B: Alijibu, "'Umpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa moyo wako mzima, kwa nafsi yako nzima, kwa nguvu zako zote na kwa akili yako nzima,' na 'umpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe.'"
sw.R: Yule mtu alijibu, "'Mpende Bwana Mungu wako kwa utu wako wote: kwa moyo wako wote, kwa nafsi yako yote, kwa nguvu zako zote na kwa akili yako yote.' Tena, 'Mpende jirani yako kama vile unavyojipenda wewe mwenyewe.'"

vi.L: Và ông đáp lời: "'Ngươi phải yêu thương Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, với cả tấm lòng ngươi, với cả linh hồn ngươi, với cả sức lực ngươi, và với cả trí óc ngươi', và 'người lân cận như chính mình.'"
vi.B: Ông trả lời: "'Ngươi phải yêu thương Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi, bằng cả tấm lòng, cả linh hồn, cả sức lực và cả trí óc của ngươi', và 'yêu thương người lân cận như chính mình.'"
vi.R: Người ấy trả lời: "'Hãy yêu thương Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời của mình, bằng cả con người mình: hết lòng, hết linh hồn, hết sức lực và hết trí óc.' Và: 'Hãy yêu thương người khác như yêu chính mình.'"

decisions.choice: Deuteronomy 6:5, with mind added
alternatives: a summary in the expert's own words
decisions.reason: The man quotes the command that follows "Hear, O Israel" (Deuteronomy 6:4-5), which Jews recited daily. The Hebrew has heart, soul and strength; the form here adds the mind, as in Mark 12:30. "Lord" stands for the divine name in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: Leviticus 19:18: your neighbor as yourself
decisions.reason: The command comes from Leviticus 19, where the neighbor is a fellow Israelite; the same chapter tells Israel to love the foreigner living among them as themselves (Leviticus 19:34). Jesus joins the same two commands in Mark 12:29-31.

decisions.choice: heart, soul, strength, mind: the whole person
alternatives: four separate parts of a person
decisions.reason: Together the words mean every part of one's life: will, feelings, energy and thought.

decisions.choice: you shall love: a command
decisions.reason: The future tense in the law gives a command.

decisions.choice: as you love yourself (B); Love your neighbor as much as you love yourself (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek does not repeat the verb. Balanced and Readable supply "love" so that the second command can be read on its own.

decisions.choice: with everything you are
decisions.reason: Readable sums up the list before giving it.

decisions.choice: quotation marks within the speech
decisions.reason: The man answers by quoting two passages of the law, so the quoted words are marked inside his speech.

decisions.choice: prójimo
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the one near you, any fellow human being (meaning decision m2). "Vecino" is the person next door; "prójimo" is the Spanish word for the neighbor of this command, and the question in 10:29 and 10:36 turns on it.

decisions.choice: ta pensée (L); ton esprit (B); ton intelligence (R)
decisions.reason: As in Mark 12:30: the word means the mind, the power to think. Literal keeps the close "pensée", Balanced the usual "esprit", Readable the plainest "intelligence".

decisions.choice: L’homme (R)
decisions.reason: English Readable keeps "The man"; French names him too, since the previous record's speaker was Jesus.

decisions.choice: nafsi (soul)
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 22:37: one of the words for the whole person (meaning decision m3). "Roho" is also the word for the Spirit and for breath; "nafsi" keeps the sense of the self.

decisions.choice: "Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi", "ngươi", "người lân cận" (L, B), "người khác" (R), as in Mark 12:30-31
decisions.reason: The Greek has kyrios, so "Chúa" with no divine-name span; the solemn "ngươi" of the commandment and the words for neighbor are those of the Vietnamese Mark 12:30-31, so the same commandment reads alike.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ· Ὀρθῶς ἀπεκρίθης· τοῦτο ποίει καὶ ζήσῃ.

records.literal_gloss: He said then to him, Correctly you answered; this do and you will live.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to him, "You have answered correctly; do this and you will live."
en.B: Jesus told him, "Your answer is right. Do this, and you will live."
en.R: Jesus said, "You are right. If you do this, you will live."

es.L: Y le dijo: «Has respondido correctamente; haz esto y vivirás».
es.B: Jesús le dijo: «Tu respuesta es correcta. Haz esto y vivirás».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Tienes razón. Si haces esto, vivirás».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui dit : « Tu as répondu correctement ; fais cela et tu vivras. »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Tu as bien répondu. Fais cela, et tu vivras. »
fr.R: Jésus a dit : « Tu as raison. Si tu fais cela, tu vivras. »

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Umejibu sawa; lifanye hili, nawe utaishi."
sw.B: Yesu alimwambia, "Jibu lako ni sahihi. Fanya hivyo, nawe utaishi."
sw.R: Yesu alisema, "Uko sawa. Ukifanya hivi, utaishi."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với ông: "Ông đã trả lời đúng; hãy làm điều đó thì ông sẽ được sống."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu bảo ông: "Ông trả lời đúng lắm. Hãy làm như thế thì ông sẽ được sống."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói: "Ông nói đúng. Nếu ông làm như thế, ông sẽ được sống."

decisions.choice: do this and you will live: echoing Leviticus 18:5
decisions.reason: God told Israel to keep his laws, which a person must do to live (Leviticus 18:5). "You will live" answers the question about eternal life (10:25).

decisions.choice: do: keep on doing
decisions.reason: The present tense means to keep doing it, as a way of life.

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

source.text: Ὁ δὲ θέλων δικαιῶσαι ἑαυτὸν εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν· Καὶ τίς ἐστίν μου πλησίον;

records.literal_gloss: But wanting to justify himself he said to Jesus, And who is my neighbor?

en.L: But wanting to justify himself, he said to Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
en.B: But the man wanted to show that he was in the right, so he asked Jesus, "And who counts as my neighbor?"
en.R: But the man wanted to show that he had done nothing wrong. So he asked Jesus, "Who is my neighbor?"

es.L: Pero él, queriendo justificarse a sí mismo, dijo a Jesús: «¿Y quién es mi prójimo?».
es.B: Pero el hombre quería mostrar que estaba en lo cierto, así que le preguntó a Jesús: «¿Y quién cuenta como mi prójimo?».
es.R: Pero el hombre quería mostrar que no había hecho nada malo. Por eso le preguntó a Jesús: «¿Quién es mi prójimo?».

fr.L: Mais lui, voulant se justifier, dit à Jésus : « Et qui est mon prochain ? »
fr.B: Mais l’homme voulait montrer qu’il était dans son droit ; il demanda donc à Jésus : « Et qui est-ce qui compte comme mon prochain ? »
fr.R: Mais l’homme voulait montrer qu’il n’avait rien fait de mal. Alors il a demandé à Jésus : « Qui est mon prochain ? »

sw.L: Lakini akitaka kujionyesha kuwa mwenye haki, alimwambia Yesu, "Na jirani yangu ni nani?"
sw.B: Lakini mtu huyo alitaka kuonyesha kwamba yuko sahihi, kwa hiyo akamwuliza Yesu, "Je, ni nani anayehesabiwa kuwa jirani yangu?"
sw.R: Lakini mtu huyo alitaka kuonyesha kwamba hakufanya kosa lolote. Kwa hiyo alimwuliza Yesu, "Jirani yangu ni nani?"

vi.L: Nhưng vì muốn tự xưng mình là công chính, ông nói với Đức Giê-xu: "Vậy ai là người lân cận của tôi?"
vi.B: Nhưng vì muốn chứng tỏ mình là đúng, ông hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Vậy ai mới được kể là người lân cận của tôi?"
vi.R: Nhưng người ấy muốn tỏ ra mình không làm gì sai. Vì vậy ông hỏi Đức Giê-xu: "Ai là người lân cận của tôi?"

decisions.choice: justify himself: show himself to be in the right
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for righteousness. Here it means defending himself, as in 16:15: by limiting whom he had to love, or by showing his question was a real one.

decisions.choice: who is my neighbor: how far does the command reach?
decisions.reason: Leviticus 19 speaks of fellow Israelites and of foreigners living in the land. The question asks where the duty to love stops.

decisions.choice: the man
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the subject.

decisions.choice: counts as
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that the question is about who qualifies.

decisions.choice: le prochain, every level, Readable included
decisions.reason: The whole exchange turns on this word (10:27, 29, 36), so Readable keeps "prochain", which French readers know from the commandment, rather than the looser "les autres" Mark 12:31 uses at Readable.

decisions.choice: "tự xưng mình là công chính" (L); "chứng tỏ mình là đúng" (B); "tỏ ra mình không làm gì sai" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 7:29 and 7:35 for the same verb: here he wants to show himself in the right (meaning decision), not Paul's sense of being justified by God.

source.text: ὑπολαβὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἄνθρωπός τις κατέβαινεν ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς Ἰεριχὼ καὶ λῃσταῖς περιέπεσεν, οἳ καὶ ἐκδύσαντες αὐτὸν καὶ πληγὰς ἐπιθέντες ἀπῆλθον ἀφέντες ἡμιθανῆ.

records.literal_gloss: Taking up Jesus said, A man certain was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and robbers fell among, who both having stripped him and blows having laid on went away having left half dead.

en.L: Taking [this] up, Jesus said, "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who stripped him and laid blows on [him] and went away, leaving [him] half dead.
en.B: Jesus took up the question and said, "A man was on his way down from Jerusalem to Jericho when robbers set on him. They tore off his clothes, gave him a beating, and went off and left him lying there half dead.
en.R: Jesus answered with a story. "A man was walking down the road from Jerusalem to Jericho. Robbers attacked him. They took his clothes, beat him up, and ran off. They left him lying there, almost dead.

es.L: Retomando [la pregunta], Jesús dijo: «Cierto hombre bajaba de Jerusalén a Jericó y cayó entre bandidos, que, después de despojarlo y de cargarlo de golpes, se fueron dejándolo medio muerto.
es.B: Jesús retomó la pregunta y dijo: «Un hombre bajaba de Jerusalén a Jericó cuando unos bandidos lo asaltaron. Le arrancaron la ropa, le dieron una paliza y se marcharon, dejándolo tirado y medio muerto.
es.R: Jesús le contestó con una historia: «Un hombre iba por el camino que baja de Jerusalén a Jericó. Unos bandidos lo atacaron. Le quitaron la ropa, lo golpearon y se escaparon. Lo dejaron allí tirado, casi muerto.

fr.L: Reprenant [la parole], Jésus dit : « Un homme descendait de Jérusalem à Jéricho, et il est tombé sur des brigands, qui, après l’avoir dépouillé et l’avoir roué de coups, sont partis en le laissant à demi mort.
fr.B: Jésus reprit la parole : « Un homme descendait de Jérusalem à Jéricho quand des brigands l’ont attaqué. Ils lui ont arraché ses vêtements, l’ont roué de coups, puis ils sont partis en le laissant à moitié mort.
fr.R: Jésus a répondu par une histoire : « Un homme descendait la route de Jérusalem à Jéricho. Des bandits l’ont attaqué. Ils lui ont pris ses vêtements, ils l’ont frappé, puis ils se sont enfuis. Ils l’ont laissé là, presque mort.

sw.L: Yesu, akilichukua [swali hilo], akasema, "Mtu fulani alikuwa akiteremka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Yeriko, akaangukia kati ya majambazi, ambao walimvua nguo na kumtia mapigo, wakaondoka wakimwacha nusu mfu.
sw.B: Yesu alilijibu swali hilo, akasema, "Mtu mmoja alikuwa safarini akiteremka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Yeriko, majambazi wakamvamia. Walimvua nguo, wakampiga, kisha wakaenda zao, wakamwacha amelala pale nusu mfu.
sw.R: Yesu alimjibu kwa kumsimulia hadithi. "Mtu mmoja alikuwa akitembea katika barabara inayoteremka kutoka Yerusalemu kwenda Yeriko. Majambazi walimshambulia. Walichukua nguo zake, wakampiga, wakakimbia. Walimwacha amelala pale, karibu kufa.

vi.L: Đức Giê-xu tiếp lời và nói: "Có một người kia đi xuống từ Giê-ru-sa-lem đến Giê-ri-cô, và rơi vào tay bọn cướp; chúng lột đồ người ấy, đánh đập, rồi bỏ đi, để người ấy nửa sống nửa chết.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp lại: "Có một người đi từ Giê-ru-sa-lem xuống Giê-ri-cô thì bị bọn cướp tấn công. Chúng lột hết quần áo người ấy, đánh đập, rồi bỏ đi, để mặc người ấy nằm đó, gần chết.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời bằng một câu chuyện: "Có một người đi trên con đường từ Giê-ru-sa-lem xuống thành Giê-ri-cô. Bọn cướp tấn công người ấy. Chúng lấy hết quần áo, đánh người ấy một trận, rồi bỏ chạy. Chúng để người ấy nằm đó, gần như đã chết.

decisions.choice: taking it up: replying to the question
decisions.reason: The verb means to take up what someone has said and answer it.

decisions.choice: going down from Jerusalem to Jericho: a steep road through the desert
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stands high in the hills; Jericho lies near the Jordan, far below. The road ran down through the dry and lonely Judean wilderness, where robbers could attack travelers.

decisions.choice: robbers: bandits who rob by force
decisions.reason: The word means violent bandits, as in "a den of robbers" (19:46).

decisions.choice: half dead: near death
decisions.reason: He was alive but looked as if he might be dead.

decisions.choice: answered with a story
decisions.reason: Readable says that what follows is a story Jesus tells.

decisions.choice: robbers set on him
decisions.reason: Balanced uses an everyday phrase for being attacked.

decisions.choice: bandidos
decisions.reason: The word used across the New Testament drafts: these men rob by force on the road (meaning decision m3), which "bandido" says and "ladrón", a thief who steals unseen, does not.

decisions.choice: the story Jesus tells in the passé composé at every level, with the imperfect for the background ("descendait")
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced, as in the narration
decisions.reason: The story is part of Jesus's speech, and spoken French tells a story in the passé composé; the style guide (section 9) sets this for the parables at every level. The narrative frame ("Jésus dit", "Jésus reprit la parole") keeps the passé simple at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: majambazi
decisions.reason: The word used across the New Testament drafts: these men rob by force on the road (meaning decision m3), which "majambazi" says; "wezi" are thieves who steal unseen.

decisions.choice: "bọn cướp"; "chúng" for the robbers; "Giê-ri-cô"
decisions.reason: Bandits who rob by force (meaning decision); "chúng" is the usual pronoun for wrongdoers in a story. The Protestant form of the town's name, as in Mark 10:46.

source.text: κατὰ συγκυρίαν δὲ ἱερεύς τις κατέβαινεν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ἀντιπαρῆλθεν·

records.literal_gloss: By chance now a priest certain was going down on the road that, and having seen him passed by on the other side.

en.L: Now by chance a certain priest was going down on that road, and seeing him, he passed by on the other side.
en.B: It so happened that a priest was traveling down by that same road. He saw the man, but went past him, keeping to the far side.
en.R: It happened that a priest was going down that same road. When he saw the man, he went by on the other side of the road.

es.L: Y por casualidad un sacerdote bajaba por aquel camino, y al verlo, pasó de largo por el otro lado.
es.B: Dio la casualidad de que un sacerdote bajaba por ese mismo camino. Vio al hombre, pero pasó de largo por el lado opuesto.
es.R: Por casualidad, un sacerdote bajaba por ese mismo camino. Cuando vio al hombre, se pasó al otro lado del camino y siguió adelante.

fr.L: Or, par hasard, un prêtre descendait par ce chemin-là, et, l’ayant vu, il est passé de l’autre côté.
fr.B: Il s’est trouvé qu’un prêtre descendait par cette même route. Il a vu l’homme, mais il est passé sans s’arrêter, en se tenant de l’autre côté.
fr.R: Par hasard, un prêtre descendait la même route. Quand il a vu l’homme, il est passé de l’autre côté de la route.

sw.L: Basi kwa bahati kuhani fulani alikuwa akiteremka katika njia ile, na alipomwona, akapita upande wa pili.
sw.B: Ilitokea kwamba kuhani mmoja alikuwa akiteremka kwa njia hiyo hiyo. Alimwona yule mtu, lakini akapita, akishika upande wa pili wa njia.
sw.R: Ilitokea kwamba kuhani mmoja alikuwa akipita katika barabara hiyo hiyo. Alipomwona yule mtu, alivuka akapita upande wa pili wa barabara.

vi.L: Tình cờ có một thầy tế lễ kia đi xuống trên con đường ấy, và thấy người ấy, thì tránh qua phía bên kia mà đi.
vi.B: Tình cờ có một thầy tế lễ cũng đi xuống con đường đó. Thấy người ấy, ông tránh sang phía bên kia đường mà đi qua.
vi.R: Tình cờ có một thầy tế lễ cũng đi xuống con đường đó. Khi thấy người bị nạn, ông đi qua phía bên kia đường.

decisions.choice: priest: a descendant of Aaron who served at the temple
decisions.reason: Priests served in the temple in turns (1:8-9) and lived in Jerusalem and the towns of Judea. The story gives no reason why he passed by. The law kept priests from making themselves unclean through a dead body (Leviticus 21:1), but the story does not say this was his reason.

decisions.choice: passed by on the other side: went past on the opposite side
decisions.reason: The verb means to go past on the opposite side. He saw the man and kept his distance.

decisions.choice: by chance: as it happened
decisions.reason: The story turns on who happens to come along.

decisions.choice: the man
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear who is seen.

decisions.choice: "thầy tế lễ"
decisions.reason: The Protestant word, as in Luke 1:5 and John 1:19.

source.text: ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ Λευίτης κατὰ τὸν τόπον ἐλθὼν καὶ ἰδὼν ἀντιπαρῆλθεν.

records.literal_gloss: Likewise now also a Levite having come to the place and having seen passed by on the other side.

en.L: And likewise a Levite also, coming to the place and seeing [him], passed by on the other side.
en.B: A Levite did the same. He came to the spot, saw him, and went past on the far side.
en.R: Then a Levite came to that place. He also saw the man and went by on the other side.

es.L: Y de igual modo también un levita, llegando al lugar y viendo [al hombre], pasó de largo por el otro lado.
es.B: Lo mismo hizo un levita: llegó a aquel sitio, lo vio y pasó de largo por el lado opuesto.
es.R: Después llegó a ese lugar un levita. Él también vio al hombre y pasó por el otro lado del camino.

fr.L: Et de même aussi un Lévite, arrivé à cet endroit et [l’]ayant vu, est passé de l’autre côté.
fr.B: Un Lévite a fait de même : il est arrivé à cet endroit, il a vu l’homme et il est passé à l’écart, de l’autre côté.
fr.R: Ensuite, un Lévite est arrivé à cet endroit. Lui aussi a vu l’homme, et il est passé de l’autre côté.

sw.L: Na vivyo hivyo Mlawi naye, alipofika mahali pale na kumwona, akapita upande wa pili.
sw.B: Mlawi naye alifanya vivyo hivyo. Alifika mahali pale, akamwona, akapita upande wa pili.
sw.R: Kisha Mlawi mmoja alifika mahali hapo. Yeye pia alimwona yule mtu, akapita upande wa pili wa barabara.

vi.L: Cũng vậy, một người Lê-vi đi đến chỗ ấy, thấy [người ấy], cũng tránh qua phía bên kia mà đi.
vi.B: Một người Lê-vi cũng làm như vậy. Ông đến chỗ đó, thấy người ấy, rồi tránh sang phía bên kia mà đi qua.
vi.R: Rồi một người Lê-vi đến chỗ đó. Ông cũng thấy người bị nạn, nhưng lại đi qua phía bên kia đường.

decisions.choice: Levite: a member of the tribe of Levi who helped the priests at the temple
decisions.reason: Levites were descendants of Levi who were not priests. They served at the temple as the priests' helpers, guards and singers (Numbers 3:5-9; 1 Chronicles 23:28-32). Like the priest, he was a man whose work was the service of God.

decisions.choice: likewise also: the same thing happens again
alternatives: the Levite was with the priest
decisions.reason: The second man repeats what the first did, word for word.

decisions.choice: the man
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the object the Greek leaves understood.

source.text: Σαμαρίτης δέ τις ὁδεύων ἦλθεν κατ’ αὐτὸν καὶ ἰδὼν ἐσπλαγχνίσθη, καὶ προσελθὼν κατέδησεν τὰ τραύματα αὐτοῦ ἐπιχέων ἔλαιον καὶ οἶνον, ἐπιβιβάσας δὲ αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον κτῆνος ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς πανδοχεῖον καὶ ἐπεμελήθη αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: A Samaritan however certain journeying came upon him, and having seen was moved with compassion, \v 34 and having approached bound up the wounds of him pouring on oil and wine, having put then him on the own animal brought him to an inn and took care of him.

en.L: But a certain Samaritan who was traveling came upon him, and seeing [him], he was moved with compassion, \v 34 and coming near he bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine, and putting him on his own animal, he brought him to an inn and cared for him.
en.B: Then a Samaritan, who was on a journey, came to where the man lay. When he saw him, his heart went out to him. \v 34 He went over to him, poured oil and wine on his wounds and bound them up. Then he lifted him onto his own animal, took him to an inn, and looked after him.
en.R: But then a Samaritan came along on his travels. When he came to the man and saw him, he felt deeply sorry for him. \v 34 He went over to him. He poured olive oil and wine on the man's wounds and wrapped them up. Then he put the man on his own donkey and took him to an inn. There he took care of him.

es.L: Pero cierto samaritano que iba de viaje llegó hasta él y, al verlo, se le conmovieron las entrañas; \v 34 y acercándose, le ató las heridas, derramando sobre ellas aceite y vino, y subiéndolo a su propia bestia, lo condujo a una posada y se ocupó de él.
es.B: Pero un samaritano que estaba de viaje llegó adonde estaba el hombre, y cuando lo vio, sintió una profunda compasión por él. \v 34 Se acercó, le echó aceite y vino en las heridas y se las vendó. Después lo montó en su propio animal, lo llevó a una posada y lo atendió.
es.R: Pero luego pasó por allí un samaritano que iba de viaje. Cuando llegó junto al hombre y lo vio, sintió mucha lástima por él. \v 34 Se acercó a él. Le echó aceite de oliva y vino en las heridas, y se las envolvió con vendas. Luego subió al hombre a su propio burro y lo llevó a una posada. Allí lo cuidó.

fr.L: Mais un certain Samaritain qui était en voyage est arrivé près de lui, et, [l’]ayant vu, il a été pris de compassion ; \v 34 et, s’étant approché, il a bandé ses plaies en y versant de l’huile et du vin ; puis, l’ayant fait monter sur sa propre monture, il l’a conduit à une auberge et a pris soin de lui.
fr.B: Puis un Samaritain, qui était en voyage, est arrivé à l’endroit où l’homme était étendu. Quand il l’a vu, il a été saisi de pitié pour lui. \v 34 Il s’est approché, a versé de l’huile et du vin sur ses plaies et les a bandées. Ensuite il l’a installé sur sa propre bête, l’a emmené dans une auberge et s’est occupé de lui.
fr.R: Mais ensuite, un Samaritain qui voyageait est passé par là. Quand il est arrivé près de l’homme et qu’il l’a vu, il a eu profondément pitié de lui. \v 34 Il s’est approché de lui. Il a versé de l’huile d’olive et du vin sur ses blessures, et il les a entourées de bandes. Puis il a mis l’homme sur son âne et il l’a emmené dans une auberge. Là, il s’est occupé de lui.

sw.L: Lakini Msamaria fulani aliyekuwa katika safari alikuja pale alipokuwa, na alipomwona, moyo wake ukaguswa kwa huruma, \v 34 naye akamsogelea akayafunga majeraha yake, akiyamwagia mafuta na divai; kisha akamweka juu ya mnyama aliyekuwa akimpanda yeye mwenyewe, akamfikisha kwenye nyumba ya kulala wageni, akamhudumia.
sw.B: Lakini Msamaria mmoja aliyekuwa akisafiri alifika pale yule mtu alipokuwa amelala. Alipomwona, moyo wake ulijaa huruma. \v 34 Alimwendea, akamimina mafuta na divai kwenye majeraha yake, akayafunga. Kisha akampakia juu ya mnyama wake mwenyewe, akampeleka kwenye nyumba ya wageni, akamtunza.
sw.R: Lakini kisha Msamaria mmoja aliyekuwa safarini akapita pale. Alipofika kwa yule mtu na kumwona, alimwonea huruma sana. \v 34 Alimkaribia. Alimimina mafuta ya zeituni na divai kwenye majeraha yake, akayafunga kwa vitambaa. Kisha alimpandisha juu ya punda wake mwenyewe, akampeleka kwenye nyumba ya wageni. Huko alimtunza.

vi.L: Nhưng một người Sa-ma-ri kia đang đi đường đến gần người ấy, và thấy [người ấy] thì động lòng thương xót, \v 34 và đến gần băng bó các vết thương của người ấy, đổ dầu và rượu vào, rồi đặt người ấy lên con vật cưỡi của mình, đem đến một quán trọ và chăm sóc người ấy.
vi.B: Nhưng có một người Sa-ma-ri đi đường đến chỗ người ấy nằm. Thấy người ấy, ông động lòng thương xót. \v 34 Ông đến gần, đổ dầu và rượu lên các vết thương rồi băng bó lại. Rồi ông đỡ người ấy lên con vật cưỡi của mình, đưa đến một quán trọ và chăm sóc người ấy.
vi.R: Nhưng rồi có một người Sa-ma-ri đang đi đường đến chỗ đó. Khi thấy người bị nạn, ông rất thương xót. \v 34 Ông đến gần, đổ dầu ô-liu và rượu lên các vết thương rồi băng lại. Sau đó ông đặt người ấy lên lưng con lừa của mình, đưa đến một quán trọ và chăm sóc người ấy ở đó.

decisions.choice: Samaritan: one of the people of Samaria, whom Jews counted as enemies
decisions.reason: Jews and Samaritans were hostile to each other (9:52-53; John 4:9). After a priest and a Levite, the third traveler is not a Jew at all. He is a figure in Jesus's story.

decisions.choice: was moved with compassion: felt a deep pity that led to action
decisions.reason: Luke uses this verb of Jesus at Nain (7:13) and of the father of the lost son (15:20).

decisions.choice: oil and wine: used to treat wounds
alternatives: a meal for the wounded man
decisions.reason: Wine helped to clean a wound, and olive oil soothed it (compare Isaiah 1:6, where wounds have not been softened with oil).

decisions.choice: animal: a beast for riding or carrying loads, probably a donkey
decisions.reason: The word means any domestic animal used for work. The Samaritan walks so that the wounded man can ride.

decisions.choice: inn: a lodging place that took in travelers
alternatives: a guest room in a house
decisions.reason: The word means a place that receives all comers, with a keeper (10:35). It is a different word from the guest room of 2:7.

decisions.choice: poured oil and wine on his wounds and bound them up
alternatives: bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the steps in the order they would be done.

decisions.choice: his heart went out to him
decisions.reason: An everyday phrase for deep pity.

decisions.choice: donkey
decisions.reason: Readable names the likely animal (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: se le conmovieron las entrañas (L); sintió una profunda compasión (B); sintió mucha lástima (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb places this pity in the inner parts, and it leads to action (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the picture with "entrañas", the word the drafts use for that inner seat of feeling; Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: moyo wake ukaguswa kwa huruma (L); moyo wake ulijaa huruma (B); alimwonea huruma sana (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb places this pity in the inner parts, and it leads to action (meaning decision m2); Swahili places such feeling in the heart, "moyo", the drafts' word for that inner seat, and Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "động lòng thương xót" (L, B); "rất thương xót" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Luke 7:13 and Mark 6:34 for the same verb; "thương hại" can sound condescending.

decisions.choice: "con vật cưỡi" (L, B); "con lừa" (R); "quán trọ" for the inn
decisions.reason: A beast for riding, probably a donkey (meaning decision); Readable names it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον ἐκβαλὼν δύο δηνάρια ἔδωκεν τῷ πανδοχεῖ καὶ εἶπεν· Ἐπιμελήθητι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὅ τι ἂν προσδαπανήσῃς ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ ἐπανέρχεσθαί με ἀποδώσω σοι.

records.literal_gloss: And on the next day having taken out two denarii he gave to the innkeeper and said, Take care of him, and whatever more you might spend, I in the returning of me will repay you.

en.L: And on the next day, taking out two denarii, he gave [them] to the innkeeper and said, 'Take care of him, and whatever more you spend, I will repay you when I come back.'
en.B: The next day he took out two denarii and handed them to the innkeeper. 'Care for him,' he said, 'and if you spend anything more, I will pay you back on my return.'
en.R: The next day he took out two silver coins and gave them to the man who ran the inn. He said, 'Take care of this man. If it costs you more than this, I will pay you when I come back this way.'

es.L: Y al día siguiente, sacando dos denarios, [se los] dio al posadero y dijo: “Cuida de él, y lo que gastes de más, yo te lo pagaré cuando regrese”.
es.B: Al día siguiente sacó dos denarios y se los entregó al posadero. “Cuídalo —le dijo—, y si gastas algo más, te lo devolveré a mi regreso”.
es.R: Al día siguiente sacó dos monedas de plata y se las dio al dueño de la posada. Le dijo: “Cuida a este hombre. Si te cuesta más que esto, yo te lo pagaré cuando vuelva por aquí”.

fr.L: Et le lendemain, sortant deux deniers, il [les] a donnés à l’aubergiste et a dit : “Prends soin de lui, et tout ce que tu dépenseras en plus, moi, à mon retour, je te le rembourserai.”
fr.B: Le lendemain, il a sorti deux deniers et les a remis à l’aubergiste. “Occupe-toi de lui, lui a-t-il dit, et si tu dépenses davantage, je te le rendrai à mon retour.”
fr.R: Le lendemain, il a sorti deux pièces d’argent et il les a données au patron de l’auberge. Il lui a dit : “Prends soin de cet homme. Si cela te coûte plus, je te paierai quand je repasserai par ici.”

sw.L: Kesho yake, alitoa dinari mbili akamkabidhi mtunza nyumba ya wageni, akasema, 'Umwangalie, na gharama yoyote ya ziada utakayotumia, mimi mwenyewe nitakurudishia nikirudi.'
sw.B: Kesho yake alitoa dinari mbili akampa mwenye nyumba ya wageni. Akamwambia, 'Mwangalie vizuri, na ukitumia chochote zaidi, nitakurudishia nikirudi.'
sw.R: Kesho yake alitoa sarafu mbili za fedha, akampa mtu aliyeendesha nyumba ile ya wageni. Akamwambia, 'Mtunze mtu huyu. Kama gharama zitazidi hizi, nitakulipa nitakapopita tena hapa.'

vi.L: Và hôm sau, ông lấy ra hai đơ-ni-ê đưa cho chủ quán và nói: 'Hãy chăm sóc người này, và nếu tốn thêm bao nhiêu, khi trở lại chính tôi sẽ trả cho anh.'
vi.B: Hôm sau, ông lấy ra hai đơ-ni-ê đưa cho chủ quán và dặn: 'Xin anh chăm sóc người này. Nếu tốn thêm bao nhiêu, khi trở lại tôi sẽ trả cho anh.'
vi.R: Hôm sau, ông lấy ra hai đồng bạc đưa cho người chủ quán trọ và nói: 'Xin anh chăm sóc người này. Nếu tốn hơn số tiền này, khi trở lại đây tôi sẽ trả thêm cho anh.'

decisions.choice: two denarii: two days' wages
decisions.reason: A denarius was a Roman silver coin, the usual pay for a day's work (7:41; Matthew 20:2). Two would pay for the man's care for a while.

decisions.choice: I will repay you: the Samaritan himself takes on the cost
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" is stressed in the Greek. He promises to come back that way and settle the bill.

decisions.choice: silver coins (R); denarii (L, B)
decisions.reason: As in 7:41. A modern sum would be misleading, since wages differ from place to place; the meaning decision gives the coin's worth.

decisions.choice: the man who ran the inn
decisions.reason: Readable says what an innkeeper is.

decisions.choice: dos denarios (L, B); dos monedas de plata (R), with no units span
decisions.reason: The English names the coins here with no units span (rendering decision r-en-1), so Spanish does the same; a denarius was a day's wage (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: dinari mbili (L, B); sarafu mbili za fedha (R), with no units span
decisions.reason: The English names the coins here with no units span (rendering decision r-en-1), so Swahili does the same; a denarius was a day's wage (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "đơ-ni-ê" (L, B); "đồng bạc" (R) for denarii
alternatives: a units setting with a modern value
decisions.reason: As in Luke 7:41: the coin's name at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says what the coins were, as the English Readable does; the English has no units span here.

decisions.choice: "anh" for the innkeeper and "tôi" for the Samaritan
decisions.reason: Two grown men doing business speak to each other with the ordinary polite "anh" and "tôi".

source.text: τίς τούτων τῶν τριῶν πλησίον δοκεῖ σοι γεγονέναι τοῦ ἐμπεσόντος εἰς τοὺς λῃστάς;

records.literal_gloss: Who of these three a neighbor seems to you to have become of the one having fallen among the robbers?

en.L: Which of these three seems to you to have become a neighbor to the one who fell among the robbers?"
en.B: Now which of these three, in your view, proved to be a neighbor to the man the robbers attacked?"
en.R: Now what do you think? Which of these three men acted like a neighbor to the man the robbers attacked?"

es.L: ¿Cuál de estos tres te parece que se hizo prójimo del que cayó entre los bandidos?».
es.B: Ahora bien, ¿cuál de estos tres, en tu opinión, resultó ser prójimo del hombre al que asaltaron los bandidos?».
es.R: Ahora dime, ¿qué piensas? ¿Cuál de estos tres hombres se portó como un prójimo con el hombre al que atacaron los bandidos?».

fr.L: Lequel de ces trois te semble être devenu le prochain de celui qui était tombé sur les brigands ? »
fr.B: Maintenant, selon toi, lequel de ces trois s’est montré le prochain de l’homme que les brigands avaient attaqué ? »
fr.R: Maintenant, qu’en penses-tu ? Lequel de ces trois hommes s’est comporté comme le prochain de l’homme attaqué par les bandits ? »

sw.L: Kati ya hawa watatu, ni yupi unayeona kwamba amekuwa jirani wa yule aliyeangukia kati ya majambazi?"
sw.B: Basi, kwa maoni yako, ni yupi kati ya hawa watatu aliyejionyesha kuwa jirani wa yule mtu aliyevamiwa na majambazi?"
sw.R: Sasa unadhani nini? Ni yupi kati ya watu hawa watatu aliyetenda kama jirani kwa yule mtu aliyeshambuliwa na majambazi?"

vi.L: Theo ông, trong ba người này, ai đã trở thành người lân cận của người đã rơi vào tay bọn cướp?"
vi.B: Vậy theo ông, trong ba người ấy, ai đã thật sự là người lân cận của người bị bọn cướp tấn công?"
vi.R: Bây giờ ông nghĩ sao? Trong ba người ấy, ai đã đối xử như một người lân cận với người bị bọn cướp tấn công?"

decisions.choice: became a neighbor: Jesus turns the question around
alternatives: who was the wounded man's neighbor by birth
decisions.reason: The expert asked who counted as his neighbor (10:29). Jesus asks who acted as a neighbor. The question is no longer whom one must love, but how one loves.

decisions.choice: seems to you: in your judgment
decisions.reason: Jesus asks the expert to give the answer himself.

decisions.choice: Now
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the turn from the story to the question.

decisions.choice: Now what do you think?
decisions.reason: Readable makes "seems to you" its own question.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Ὁ ποιήσας τὸ ἔλεος μετ’ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And he said, The one having done the mercy toward him.

en.L: And he said, "The one who showed mercy toward him."
en.B: He answered, "The one who was merciful to him."
en.R: The expert answered, "The one who showed him mercy."

es.L: Y él dijo: «El que mostró misericordia hacia él».
es.B: Él respondió: «El que tuvo misericordia de él».
es.R: El experto respondió: «El que le mostró misericordia».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Celui qui a pratiqué la miséricorde envers lui. »
fr.B: Il répondit : « Celui qui a fait preuve de bonté envers lui. »
fr.R: L’expert a répondu : « Celui qui a eu pitié de lui. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Yule aliyemtendea huruma."
sw.B: Alijibu, "Yule aliyemhurumia."
sw.R: Yule mtaalamu alijibu, "Yule aliyemwonyesha huruma."

vi.L: Và ông nói: "Người đã tỏ lòng thương xót với người ấy."
vi.B: Ông trả lời: "Người đã thương xót người ấy."
vi.R: Chuyên gia luật pháp trả lời: "Người đã tỏ lòng thương xót với người ấy."

decisions.choice: mercy: kindness to someone in need
decisions.reason: Mercy is a quality of God (1:50, 72, 78), shown in acts of help. The expert does not name the Samaritan.

decisions.choice: did mercy: acted with mercy
decisions.reason: The phrase, used in 1:72, is a Hebrew way of speaking: mercy is something done.

decisions.choice: The expert
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πορεύου καὶ σὺ ποίει ὁμοίως.

records.literal_gloss: Said then to him Jesus, Go and you do likewise.

en.L: And Jesus said to him, "Go, and you do likewise."
en.B: Jesus told him, "You go, then, and do the same."
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Then go and do the same thing yourself."

es.L: Y Jesús le dijo: «Ve, y tú haz de igual manera».
es.B: Jesús le dijo: «Pues ve tú y haz lo mismo».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Entonces ve y pórtate tú de la misma manera».

fr.L: Et Jésus lui dit : « Va, et toi, fais de même. »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Alors va, et toi, fais de même. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Alors va, et fais la même chose, toi aussi. »

sw.L: Na Yesu akamwambia, "Nenda, nawe utende vivyo hivyo."
sw.B: Yesu alimwambia, "Basi, nenda ukafanye vivyo hivyo wewe pia."
sw.R: Yesu alimwambia, "Basi nenda, nawe ufanye jambo hilo hilo."

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với ông: "Hãy đi, và chính ông cũng hãy làm như vậy."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu bảo ông: "Vậy ông hãy đi, và cũng làm như thế."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với ông: "Vậy thì ông hãy đi và làm giống như vậy."

decisions.choice: you do likewise: you, keep doing the same
decisions.reason: The "you" is stressed, and the present tense means a way of life. It echoes "do this and you will live" (10:28).

decisions.choice: then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark that the command follows from the expert's own answer.

source.text: Ἐν δὲ τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτοὺς αὐτὸς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς κώμην τινά· γυνὴ δέ τις ὀνόματι Μάρθα ὑπεδέξατο αὐτὸν.

records.literal_gloss: In now the going of them he entered into a village certain; a woman now certain named Martha received him.

en.L: Now as they were traveling, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} entered a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: As they went on their way, Jesus came into a village where a woman named Martha welcomed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as her guest.
en.R: As they traveled on, Jesus came to a village. A woman named Martha lived there, and she welcomed Jesus as a guest.

es.L: Y mientras ellos iban de camino, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entró en cierta aldea; y una mujer llamada Marta {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} recibió.
es.B: Mientras iban de camino, Jesús entró en una aldea, y una mujer llamada Marta {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} recibió en su casa como huésped.
es.R: Mientras seguían su viaje, Jesús llegó a una aldea. Allí vivía una mujer llamada Marta, y ella recibió a Jesús en su casa como invitado.

fr.L: Or, comme ils étaient en route, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} entra dans un certain village ; et une certaine femme nommée Marthe {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} reçut.
fr.B: Comme ils poursuivaient leur route, Jésus entra dans un village, où une femme nommée Marthe {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} reçut chez elle.
fr.R: Ils continuaient leur voyage, et Jésus est arrivé dans un village. Une femme appelée Marthe habitait là, et elle a accueilli Jésus chez elle.

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wakienda, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliingia katika kijiji fulani; na mwanamke fulani aitwaye Martha alimkaribisha.
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakiendelea na safari, Yesu aliingia katika kijiji kimoja, na mwanamke mmoja aitwaye Martha akamkaribisha kama mgeni wake.
sw.R: Walipokuwa wakiendelea na safari yao, Yesu alifika katika kijiji kimoja. Mwanamke mmoja aitwaye Martha aliishi huko, naye alimkaribisha Yesu kama mgeni.

vi.L: Và trong khi họ đang đi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào một làng kia; và có một người phụ nữ kia tên là Ma-thê tiếp đón {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Trong khi họ tiếp tục lên đường, Đức Giê-xu vào một làng kia, và có một người phụ nữ tên là Ma-thê tiếp đón {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào nhà mình.
vi.R: Trong khi đi đường, Đức Giê-xu đến một làng kia. Ở đó có một người phụ nữ tên là Ma-thê. Cô tiếp đón Đức Giê-xu vào nhà như một vị khách.

decisions.choice: received him (SBLGNT)
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "into her house" or "into the house"; some early ones end with "received him". The meaning is the same, since receiving a guest meant taking him into one's home. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: a certain village: Bethany, according to John
decisions.reason: Luke does not name it. John says Martha and Mary lived at Bethany, close to Jerusalem (John 11:1; 12:1-3). Luke places the visit on the journey to Jerusalem (9:51) without saying where.

decisions.choice: received: welcomed as a guest
decisions.reason: The verb is used of welcoming a guest (19:6; James 2:25).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus at the start of a new section.

decisions.choice: "Ma-thê"; "cô" for Martha in the narrative
decisions.reason: As in John 11, where the Vietnamese calls the sisters "cô" and "Ma-thê" the elder; the name in its Protestant form.

source.text: καὶ τῇδε ἦν ἀδελφὴ καλουμένη Μαριάμ, ἣ καὶ παρακαθεσθεῖσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἤκουεν τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And she had a sister called Mary, who also having sat at the feet of Jesus was listening to the word of him.

en.L: And she had a sister called Mary, who also, sitting at the feet of Jesus, was listening to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word.
en.B: Martha had a sister, Mary, who sat down at Jesus's feet and kept listening to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} words.
en.R: Martha had a sister named Mary. Mary sat at Jesus's feet and listened to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} teach.

es.L: Y esta tenía una hermana llamada María, que, sentándose también a los pies de Jesús, escuchaba {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra.
es.B: Marta tenía una hermana, María, que se sentó a los pies de Jesús y se quedó escuchando {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} palabras.
es.R: Marta tenía una hermana que se llamaba María. María se sentó a los pies de Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} escuchaba enseñar.

fr.L: Et elle avait une sœur appelée Marie, qui, s’étant assise aux pieds de Jésus, écoutait {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole.
fr.B: Marthe avait une sœur, Marie, qui s’assit aux pieds de Jésus et resta à écouter {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles.
fr.R: Marthe avait une sœur qui s’appelait Marie. Marie s’est assise aux pieds de Jésus, et elle {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}écoutait enseigner.

sw.L: Naye alikuwa na dada aitwaye Mariamu, ambaye naye, akiketi miguuni pa Yesu, alikuwa akilisikiliza neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.B: Martha alikuwa na dada yake, Mariamu, aliyeketi chini miguuni pa Yesu, akaendelea kusikiliza maneno {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Martha alikuwa na dada aliyeitwa Mariamu. Mariamu aliketi miguuni pa Yesu, akamsikiliza alipokuwa akifundisha.

vi.L: Và cô có một người em gái tên là Ma-ri, là người ngồi dưới chân Đức Giê-xu mà nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ma-thê có một người em gái tên là Ma-ri. Ma-ri ngồi dưới chân Đức Giê-xu và cứ lắng nghe lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy.
vi.R: Ma-thê có một người em gái tên là Ma-ri. Ma-ri ngồi dưới chân Đức Giê-xu và lắng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy dỗ.

decisions.choice: Jesus (SBLGNT)
decisions.reason: Some early manuscripts read "the Lord", as Luke calls Jesus in 10:41; others read "Jesus". Both refer to Jesus. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: sitting at the feet: the place of a disciple before a teacher
decisions.reason: Paul says he was brought up at the feet of Gamaliel (Acts 22:3), and the healed man sits at Jesus's feet (8:35). Mary takes the place of a learner.

decisions.choice: was listening: kept on listening
decisions.reason: The past continuous tense pictures her listening while Martha works (10:40).

decisions.choice: Martha
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Martha to keep the two sisters clear.

decisions.choice: listened to him teach
