decisions.reason: Readable says what his word was: his teaching.

decisions.choice: "em gái" for Mary; "Ma-ri"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say which sister is older; this follows the choice of Martha as the elder in John 11:1, which the Greek does not settle. Sitting at his feet is the place of a disciple (meaning decision).

source.text: ἡ δὲ Μάρθα περιεσπᾶτο περὶ πολλὴν διακονίαν· ἐπιστᾶσα δὲ εἶπεν· Κύριε, οὐ μέλει σοι ὅτι ἡ ἀδελφή μου μόνην με κατέλειπεν διακονεῖν;

records.literal_gloss: But Martha was distracted about much serving; having come up now she said, Lord, is it not a concern to you that the sister of me alone me has left to serve?

en.L: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and coming up, she said, "Lord, is it no concern to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} that my sister has left me to serve alone?
en.B: But Martha was being pulled in every direction by all the work of serving. She came up and said, "Lord, does it not matter to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} that my sister has left me to do the serving on my own?
en.R: But Martha was taken up with all the work of serving the guests. She came to Jesus and said, "Lord, does it not bother {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself?

es.L: Pero Marta estaba distraída con mucho servicio; y acercándose, dijo: «Señor, ¿no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} importa que mi hermana me haya dejado sola para servir?
es.B: Pero Marta andaba agobiada de un lado a otro con todo el trabajo de atender. Se acercó y dijo: «Señor, ¿no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} importa que mi hermana me haya dejado sola con todo el servicio?
es.R: Pero Marta estaba muy ocupada con todo el trabajo de atender a los invitados. Se acercó a Jesús y dijo: «Señor, ¿no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} molesta que mi hermana me haya dejado sola con todo el trabajo?

fr.L: Mais Marthe était accaparée par un service important ; s’étant approchée, elle dit : « Seigneur, cela ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} fait-il rien que ma sœur m’ait laissée seule pour servir ?
fr.B: Mais Marthe était tiraillée de tous côtés par tout le travail du service. Elle s’approcha et dit : « Seigneur, cela ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} fait rien que ma sœur m’ait laissée faire seule tout le service ?
fr.R: Mais Marthe était très occupée à servir les invités. Elle est venue vers Jésus et elle {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a dit : « Seigneur, est-ce que cela ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} gêne pas que ma sœur me laisse faire tout le travail toute seule ?

sw.L: Lakini Martha alikuwa amesumbuliwa na huduma nyingi; akaja, akasema, "Bwana, je, hujali kwamba dada yangu ameniacha nihudumu peke yangu?
sw.B: Lakini Martha alikuwa akivutwa huku na huku na kazi zote za kuhudumia. Alimjia, akasema, "Bwana, je, hujali kwamba dada yangu ameniachia kazi ya kuhudumu peke yangu?
sw.R: Lakini Martha alikuwa amejishughulisha sana na kazi zote za kuwahudumia wageni. Alimwendea Yesu, akasema, "Bwana, je, haikusumbui kwamba dada yangu ameniachia kazi yote nifanye peke yangu?

vi.L: Còn Ma-thê thì bận rộn vì nhiều việc phục vụ; và cô đến gần nói: "Thưa Chúa, em con để một mình con phục vụ mà Chúa không quan tâm sao?
vi.B: Còn Ma-thê thì cứ tất bật lo việc dọn ăn tiếp khách. Cô đến thưa: "Thưa Chúa, em con để mặc một mình con lo phục vụ mà Chúa không để ý đến sao?
vi.R: Còn Ma-thê thì cứ lo làm đủ mọi việc để phục vụ khách. Cô đến gặp Đức Giê-xu và thưa: "Thưa Chúa, em con để con làm hết mọi việc một mình. Chúa không thấy phiền lòng sao?

decisions.choice: distracted: pulled away, overburdened
decisions.reason: The verb means to be drawn off in different directions. Her many tasks pulled her away from listening to Jesus.

decisions.choice: serving: preparing and serving a meal for the guests
decisions.reason: The word means service of any kind, often serving at table (Acts 6:1-2). With Jesus and his followers as guests, there was much to do.

decisions.choice: a question expecting the answer yes
decisions.reason: The way the question is put in Greek expects that Jesus does care, and so will act.

decisions.choice: the guests; to Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says whom she was serving and whom she came to.

decisions.choice: was being pulled in every direction
decisions.reason: Balanced brings out the picture in the verb.

decisions.choice: "Thưa Chúa", "Chúa" for "you" and "con" for herself, with no setting span
decisions.reason: As Martha speaks to Jesus in John 11:21: she calls him Lord as a believer, and calls herself "con" before him; Jesus answers her as "con".

source.text: εἰπὲ οὖν αὐτῇ ἵνα μοι συναντιλάβηται.

records.literal_gloss: Say therefore to her that me she might help.

en.L: Tell her, then, to help me."
en.B: So tell her to give me a hand."
en.R: Tell her to help me!"

es.L: Dile, pues, que me ayude».
es.B: Así que dile que me eche una mano».
es.R: ¡Dile que me ayude!».

fr.L: Dis-lui donc de m’aider. »
fr.B: Dis-lui donc de me donner un coup de main. »
fr.R: Dis-lui de m’aider ! »

sw.L: Kwa hiyo mwambie ashirikiane nami."
sw.B: Basi mwambie aje anisaidie."
sw.R: Mwambie anisaidie!"

vi.L: Vậy xin Chúa bảo nó giúp con."
vi.B: Xin Chúa bảo em con phụ giúp con một tay."
vi.R: Xin Chúa bảo em con giúp con với!"

decisions.choice: help: take hold together with me, share the load
decisions.reason: The verb means to take part with someone in a task (Romans 8:26).

decisions.choice: give me a hand
decisions.reason: An everyday phrase that keeps the sense of sharing the work.

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ κύριος· Μάρθα Μάρθα, μεριμνᾷς καὶ θορυβάζῃ περὶ πολλά, ὀλίγων δέ ἐστιν χρεία ἢ ἑνός· Μαριὰμ γὰρ τὴν ἀγαθὴν μερίδα ἐξελέξατο ἥτις οὐκ ἀφαιρεθήσεται αὐτῆς.

records.literal_gloss: Answering now said to her the Lord, Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, \v 42 but of few things there is need, or of one; Mary for the good portion chose, which not will be taken away from her.

en.L: And answering, the Lord said to her, "Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, \v 42 but few things are needed, or one; for Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her."
en.B: The Lord answered her, "Martha, Martha, you are fretting and in a stir about so many things. \v 42 Yet there is need of few things, or only of one. Mary has picked the good share, and it is not going to be taken from her."
en.R: The Lord answered, "Martha, Martha, you are worrying and getting upset about lots of things. \v 42 But only a few things are needed. Really, only one thing is needed. Mary has chosen what is good, and no one will take it away from her."

es.L: Y respondiendo, el Señor le dijo: «Marta, Marta, te inquietas y te alborotas por muchas cosas, \v 42 pero hay necesidad de pocas, o de una; porque María eligió la porción buena, que no se le quitará».
es.B: El Señor le respondió: «Marta, Marta, andas preocupada y agitada por tantas cosas. \v 42 Pero hacen falta pocas, o solo una. María ha elegido la buena porción, y no se la van a quitar».
es.R: El Señor le contestó: «Marta, Marta, te preocupas y te pones nerviosa por muchas cosas. \v 42 Pero solo se necesitan unas pocas cosas. En realidad, solo una cosa es necesaria. María ha escogido lo que es bueno, y nadie se lo va a quitar».

fr.L: Et, répondant, le Seigneur lui dit : « Marthe, Marthe, tu t’inquiètes et tu t’agites pour beaucoup de choses ; \v 42 mais il est besoin de peu de choses, ou d’une seule ; car Marie a choisi la bonne part, qui ne lui sera pas enlevée. »
fr.B: Le Seigneur lui répondit : « Marthe, Marthe, tu te fais du souci et tu te mets dans tous tes états pour tant de choses ! \v 42 Pourtant, on n’a besoin que de peu de choses, ou même d’une seule. C’est la bonne part que Marie a choisie, et on ne va pas la lui retirer. »
fr.R: Le Seigneur lui a répondu : « Marthe, Marthe, tu te fais du souci et tu t’énerves pour beaucoup de choses. \v 42 Mais on n’a besoin que de quelques choses. En fait, une seule chose est nécessaire. Marie a choisi ce qui est bon, et personne ne le lui enlèvera. »

sw.L: Bwana akajibu, akamwambia, "Martha, Martha, una wasiwasi na unahangaika juu ya mambo mengi, \v 42 lakini mambo machache yanahitajika, au moja; kwa maana Mariamu amejichagulia sehemu iliyo njema, nayo haitaondolewa kwake."
sw.B: Bwana alimjibu, "Martha, Martha, unajisumbua na kuhangaika kwa mambo mengi mno. \v 42 Lakini yanahitajika mambo machache tu, au hata moja tu. Mariamu amechagua sehemu iliyo nzuri, nayo haitachukuliwa kutoka kwake."
sw.R: Bwana alijibu, "Martha, Martha, una wasiwasi na unahangaika kuhusu mambo mengi. \v 42 Lakini ni mambo machache tu yanayohitajika. Kwa kweli, ni jambo moja tu linalohitajika. Mariamu amechagua kilicho chema, na hakuna mtu atakayemnyang'anya."

decisions.choice: few things are needed, or one (SBLGNT)
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ here. Some early ones, among them Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, read "few things are needed, or one". Others, among them early papyri and most later manuscripts, read "one thing is needed". A few leave out the clause, and with it Jesus's words about Martha's worry. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: few things, or one: little is needed for the meal, and in the end only one thing matters
alternatives: only a few dishes are needed
only listening to Jesus is needed
decisions.reason: The words may mean that Martha need prepare only a few dishes, or even one; or they may point beyond the meal to the one thing that matters, listening to Jesus. Both may be meant.

decisions.choice: anxious and troubled: worried within and stirred up without
decisions.reason: The first verb is the worry Jesus warns against (12:22-26); the second means being in an uproar.

decisions.choice: the good portion: the good share, like a share of food at a meal
decisions.reason: The word means a portion or share. Jesus calls Mary's share good, not "better", though the contrast is clear. The Psalms call the LORD himself the portion of his people (Psalm 16:5; 73:26).

decisions.choice: fretting and in a stir (B); worrying and getting upset (R)
decisions.reason: Everyday words for the two verbs.

decisions.choice: no one will take it away from her
alternatives: it will not be taken away from her
decisions.reason: Readable makes the passive active, without changing the promise.

decisions.choice: la porción buena (L); la buena porción (B)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a share, like a portion of food at a meal (meaning decision m4), which fits Martha's busy kitchen; "porción" keeps that picture, where "parte" is only a part.

decisions.choice: la bonne part (L, B); ce qui est bon (R)
decisions.reason: "Part" keeps the picture of a share of food at the meal (m4) and is the ordinary French word for a share; "la meilleure part" would add a comparison the Greek does not make.

decisions.choice: "con" for Martha; "cô ấy" (L), "em ấy" (B, R) for Mary in Jesus' words
decisions.reason: As in John 11:23-26, Jesus speaks to Martha as "con". Speaking to the elder sister, Balanced and Readable refer to Mary as "em ấy", the way Vietnamese names a younger sister to the older one.

decisions.choice: "phần tốt" (L, B); "điều tốt nhất" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the good share, like a share of food at a meal; Literal and Balanced keep the picture of a portion, Readable says what she chose.
